QuestInfo.name: The Legendary Tribal Ring: Circle of Ancient Thought
QuestInfo.0: Happy to have found the remnant of the Miwok Artifacts, Kopee says she has something to tell me. Let's go and see her.
QuestInfo.1: Kopee offered to make me a Legendary Tribal Ring using the belongings of her Miwok ancestors! I should collect every artifact I find and take my findings to Kopee.
QuestInfo.2: Kopee, using the ancestors' belongings, made me a ring. I received a Circle of Ancient Thought from her! She told me she'd make me one every time I bring her an artifact. I'd better take what I find to Kopee.

0.0: Oh, my dearest friend #b#h0##k, I've been thinking about how I could repay you. And since you seem like an adventurous person, I'll make a unique gift just for you using my special ability. Aren't you curious what it might be?
0.1: I have the ability to make a ring using the artifacts that my ancestors have left behind. It's a marvelous ring I make which all the other adventurers will be jealous of! Only I, Kopee, know how to make that ring. But I can only make you the ring if you bring the required materials.
0.2: What do you say? Would you like me to make you a legendary #bCircle of Ancient Thought#k?

yes.0: Alright! You'll be able to find the belongings of my ancestors in the Miwok Artifacts. I need the belongings of my ancestors to make a #bCircle of Ancient#k Thought. Bring me #b3 Bluejay Feathers#k, #b2 Red Bird Feathers#k, and #b1 Old Tree Branch#k.
yes.1: As you may be aware already, the monsters have the #bMiwok Artifacts#k, and you must ask Miwok to retrieve the sealed treasure using the #bEnchanted Scroll#k. Hurry!

no.0: Oh, hm, it's truly a special ring. Are you sure you don't want it? Toh Relicseeker and I are planning to leave here sometime soon. Make sure you come back and see me if you change your mind later.

1.0: Ah! you've brought back all the materials I need! Alright, it's time for me to show you my special ability. Now, hand me what you've brought.

yes.0: OOOOAAAAAH! Here, a #bCircle of Ancient Thoughts#k has been made just for you. What do you think? You like it? The effect of the ring differs depending on my condition at the time of making the ring. I hope you like it! If you bring me more materials, I can make you another one.

item.0: Too bad, but you haven't brought me everything I need to make the ring. I need #b3 Bluejay Feathers#k, #b2 Red Bird Feathers#k, #b1 Old Tree Branch#k in order to make the ring.
